reusableActivities.name: Submission Intake Form

reusableActivities.name: Clearance Check

reusableActivities.name: Run Risk Score
reusableActivities.description: Compute the property risk score by combining enrichment, claims, and CAT exposure inputs.

reusableActivities.name: Loss Ratio Review
reusableActivities.description: Agent reviews historical loss ratio against industry benchmarks and flags outliers.

reusableActivities.name: Generate Indicative Quote
reusableActivities.description: Produce an indicative premium and per-location pricing breakdown for underwriter review.

reusableActivities.name: Apply Pricing Adjustments
reusableActivities.description: Apply schedule rating credits and debits, broker commission, and any manual UW adjustments.

reusableActivities.name: Underwriter Review
reusableActivities.description: Senior underwriter signs off on pricing, terms, and any non-standard exceptions.

reusableActivities.name: Quote Acceptance
reusableActivities.description: Capture broker acceptance, confirm bind authority, and record subjectivities cleared.

reusableActivities.name: Generate Binder Document
reusableActivities.description: Render the binder document with quoted limits, deductibles, and effective dates.

reusableActivities.name: Issue Policy
reusableActivities.description: Push the bound submission to the policy admin system and emit the policy number.

reusableActivities.name: Send Welcome Packet
reusableActivities.description: Email the welcome packet, policy documents, and broker commission statement.

reusableActivities.name: Broker Validation
reusableActivities.description: Verify broker license status, appointment, and producer code — applies to every line of business.

reusableActivities.name: Duplicate & Clearance Check
reusableActivities.description: Detect duplicate submissions and broker conflicts across all lines before underwriting starts.

reusableActivities.name: Sanctions & Watchlist Screening
reusableActivities.description: Screen the insured and related parties against OFAC and global sanctions/watchlists.

reusableActivities.name: Document Completeness Review
reusableActivities.description: Confirm all required documents are present and legible before the submission advances.

reusableActivities.name: Submission Summary Generation
reusableActivities.description: Generate an AI summary of the submission and its documents for underwriter review.

reusableActivities.name: Assign Underwriter
reusableActivities.description: Route the submission to the appropriate underwriter or queue based on assignment rules.

categories.name: Property Characteristics
categories.description: Construction, age, size, roof, and structural attributes used to rate and price the building.

categories.name: Location & CAT Exposure
categories.description: Geocoded catastrophe exposure — flood, wind, wildfire, and earthquake — from the risk address.

categories.name: Fire Protection & Response
categories.description: Sprinklers, alarms, ISO PPC class, and distance to the responding fire station and hydrant.

categories.name: Occupancy & Operations
categories.description: How the building is used — primary occupancy, tenant mix, and on-site operations or hazards.

categories.name: Claims History
categories.description: Prior loss experience from CLUE and carrier records — frequency, severity, and open claims by peril.

categories.name: Valuation & Insurance-to-Value
categories.description: Replacement-cost valuation and insurance-to-value adequacy against the stated building limit.

categories.name: Building Code & Compliance
categories.description: Applicable building-code year, permits, and code-upgrade exposure affecting rebuild cost.

categories.name: Business Operations & Exposure
categories.description: Nature of the insured's operations — industry class, revenue, payroll, and exposure base for GL rating.

categories.name: GL Claims History
categories.description: General-liability loss history — claim counts, products-liability claims, and open reserves over 5 years.

categories.name: Safety Programs & OSHA
categories.description: Formal safety programs, training, and OSHA inspection and citation history.

categories.name: Workers Compensation Experience
categories.description: Experience-modification factor and prior workers' comp loss runs indicating workforce risk.

categories.name: Financial Stability & Credit
categories.description: Business credit score, liens, and financial-health signals that inform account stability.

categories.name: Products Liability Exposure
categories.description: Exposure from products manufactured, sold, or distributed — recalls, warnings, and high-hazard lines.

categories.name: Contractual & Operations Risk
categories.description: Contractual liability assumed through leases, subcontractor agreements, and hold-harmless provisions.

integrationProcedures.name: Verisk360_GetPropertyValuation
integrationProcedures.description: Pull 360Value building replacement-cost report and building characteristics.

steps.name: setRequestPayload
steps.description: Map ACORD 140 location + structural fields into Verisk request.

steps.name: callVerisk360Api
steps.description: POST /v1/360value/properties — fetch valuation + characteristics.

steps.name: cacheValuation
steps.description: Cache by latitude/longitude for 24h.

steps.name: extractFields
steps.description: Map response to Property Characteristics + Valuation enrichment fields.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return building replacement cost, construction type, year built, square footage.

integrationProcedures.name: CoreLogic_GetCATExposure
integrationProcedures.description: Geocode the address and pull all CAT-exposure data (flood, EQ, wildfire, hurricane, hail).

steps.name: geocodeAddress
steps.description: POST /geocode — resolve street address to lat/lng.

steps.name: lookupFloodZone
steps.description: GET /risk/flood — FEMA flood zone, BFE, panel id.

steps.name: lookupEarthquakeRisk
steps.description: GET /risk/earthquake — PGA, soil liquefaction, PML.

steps.name: lookupWildfireRisk
steps.description: GET /risk/wildfire — hazard severity zone + wildfire risk score.

steps.name: lookupHurricaneRisk
steps.description: GET /risk/hurricane — wind zone, distance to coast.

steps.name: aggregateExposureRisks
steps.description: Combine all CAT outputs into a single response object.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Location & CAT Exposure fields.

integrationProcedures.name: ISO_GetPublicProtectionClass
integrationProcedures.description: Fetch ISO PPC, fire-department type, hydrant distance, water supply data.

steps.name: setRequestPayload
steps.description: Build ISO request from address + lat/lng.

steps.name: callIsoPpcApi
steps.description: GET /ppc/lookup — ISO PPC class + fire protection.

steps.name: cachePpc
steps.description: Cache by ZIP + protection district for 30 days.

steps.name: extractProtectionFields
steps.description: Map PPC, hydrant distance, water supply, FD type, response time.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Fire Protection & Response fields.

integrationProcedures.name: LexisNexis_GetClaimsHistory
integrationProcedures.description: Pull 5-year commercial CLUE history and aggregate by peril.

steps.name: authenticate
steps.description: Exchange API key for short-lived bearer token.

steps.name: requestClueReport
steps.description: POST /clue/commercial/v2/lookup — request 5y claims history.

steps.name: parseClaims
steps.description: Iterate claims; bucket by peril (fire, water, theft, wind/hail).

steps.name: computeAggregates
steps.description: Total incurred, claim frequency, severity, largest claim.

steps.name: fetchIndustryBenchmarks
steps.description: Look up ISO industry-average frequency + severity.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Claims History fields.

integrationProcedures.name: DnB_GetBusinessProfile
integrationProcedures.description: Pull D&B business profile, credit scores, public records.

steps.name: matchByDuns
steps.description: If DUNS provided, lookup by DUNS; else match by legal name + address.

steps.name: fetchProfile
steps.description: GET /v1/data/duns/{duns} — base profile + entity info.

steps.name: fetchCreditScores
steps.description: GET /v1/data/duns/{duns}/credit — PAYDEX, failure score, financial stress.

steps.name: fetchPublicRecords
steps.description: GET /v1/data/duns/{duns}/public-records — liens, judgments, bankruptcies.

steps.name: mergeFields
steps.description: Combine into Business Operations + Financial Stability output.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Business Operations + Financial Stability fields.

integrationProcedures.name: OSHA_GetSafetyHistory
integrationProcedures.description: Look up OSHA inspections, violations, abatement status by establishment.

steps.name: matchEstablishment
steps.description: GET /v1/establishments?ein=… — find establishment ids.

steps.name: fetchInspections
steps.description: GET /v1/inspections?establishmentId=… (5-year window).

steps.name: fetchViolations
steps.description: For each inspection, fetch citations + abatement status.

steps.name: aggregateOshaMetrics
steps.description: Inspection count, violation count, serious violations, abatement %.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Safety Programs & OSHA fields.

integrationProcedures.name: NCCI_GetWorkersCompEMR
integrationProcedures.description: Fetch experience modification factor and recent WC claim history.

steps.name: lookupRiskId
steps.description: GET /risk-id/lookup?ein=… — resolve NCCI risk id.

steps.name: fetchEmr
steps.description: GET /experience-mod/{riskId} — current + prior EMR.

steps.name: computeTrend
steps.description: Compare current vs prior EMR → Improving / Stable / Declining.

steps.name: fetchWcClaims
steps.description: Pull WC claims from current carrier.

steps.name: returnEnrichment
steps.description: Return Workers Compensation Experience fields.

integrationProcedures.name: Enrichment_RunAllForSubmission
integrationProcedures.description: Orchestrator — fans out to all relevant provider IPs based on submission LOB and aggregates results.

steps.name: detectLineOfBusiness
steps.description: Inspect submission to determine which IPs to invoke.

steps.name: isCommercialProperty
steps.description: If submission contains Property line, run Verisk + CoreLogic + ISO + LexisNexis.

steps.name: isGeneralLiability
steps.description: If submission contains GL line, run D&B + OSHA + NCCI.

steps.name: callPropertyEnrichments
steps.description: Fan-out to property IPs in parallel and collect results.

steps.name: callGeneralLiabilityEnrichments
steps.description: Fan-out to GL IPs in parallel and collect results.

steps.name: mergeAndDedupe
steps.description: Combine outputs; resolve overlaps using source priority.

steps.name: persistEnrichmentRecord
steps.description: Persist combined enrichment record on the submission.

steps.name: returnSummary
steps.description: Return enrichment summary + any provider errors.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Location
lineCoverageEntities.description: A physical premises / site being insured. Groups one or more buildings and their contents at a single address.
lineCoverageEntities.aiMatchPromptTemplate: Match incoming location records by street address, city, state and ZIP. Treat suite/unit differences as the same location when the street address matches.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Building
lineCoverageEntities.description: An individual structure at a location. Carries construction, occupancy and valuation characteristics used for property rating.
lineCoverageEntities.aiMatchPromptTemplate: Match building records within a location by building number first, then by description/occupancy. A building with the same number at the same location is the same building.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Equipment
lineCoverageEntities.description: Machinery, boilers, and mechanical/electrical equipment at a building or location — the exposure basis for Equipment Breakdown coverage.
lineCoverageEntities.aiMatchPromptTemplate: Match equipment records by serial number when present, otherwise by manufacturer + model + building. Distinct serial numbers are distinct equipment.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Building
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers the insured structure itself — walls, roof, permanently installed fixtures and building equipment.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Business Personal Property
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers contents — furniture, inventory, machinery and equipment the insured owns or is responsible for.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Business Income & Extra Expense
lineCoverageEntities.description: Replaces lost net income and covers extra expense during the period of restoration after a covered loss.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Equipment Breakdown
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers sudden and accidental mechanical or electrical breakdown of boilers, machinery and equipment (formerly Boiler & Machinery).

lineCoverageEntities.label: Ordinance or Law
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers the increased cost to rebuild to current building codes, including demolition of undamaged portions.

attributes.label: Coverage C — Increased Cost of Construction

lineCoverageEntities.label: Loss of Rents / Rental Value
lineCoverageEntities.description: Reimburses rental income lost while a covered property is untenantable after a loss.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Signs
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers exterior building and freestanding signs against covered perils.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Debris Removal
lineCoverageEntities.description: Pays the cost to remove debris of covered property following a covered cause of loss.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Tenant Improvements & Betterments
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers permanent improvements a tenant makes to a leased space they do not own.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Outdoor Property
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers fences, antennas, trees, shrubs and plants and other outdoor property against specified perils.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Spoilage
lineCoverageEntities.description: Covers perishable stock spoilage from breakdown or contamination, power interruption and refrigeration failure.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Account
lineCoverageEntities.description: The named insured / applicant on the submission. The legal entity seeking coverage.
lineCoverageEntities.aiMatchPromptTemplate: Match incoming account records by legal name and FEIN. Treat DBA/trade-name variations as the same account when the FEIN matches.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Contact
lineCoverageEntities.description: A person associated with the account — the applicant contact, owner, or producing broker.

attributes.label: Role
attributes.description: e.g. Broker, Owner, Risk Manager, Applicant

lineCoverageEntities.label: Shared Location
lineCoverageEntities.description: A physical premises shared across lines. Its attributes are common keys usable by both General Liability and Commercial Property.
lineCoverageEntities.aiMatchPromptTemplate: Match incoming location records by street address, city, state and ZIP. Treat suite/unit differences as the same location when the street address matches.

attributes.label: Occupancy / Business Type
attributes.description: Occupancy classification used by GL class rating and Property COPE.

attributes.label: Total Square Footage
attributes.description: Total area — a Property COPE attribute and a GL exposure basis.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Loss History
lineCoverageEntities.description: Prior claims / losses reported on the submission, used for loss-run analysis.

lineCoverageEntities.label: Previous Policies
lineCoverageEntities.description: Expiring / prior policies disclosed on the submission, used for renewal comparison and rating.
